description: Validate Etemaro strategy JSON files through the Etemaro CLI and report whether each strategy is valid or invalid, plus which fields are unknown and will therefore be ignored by the runtime. Use this skill whenever the user asks to validate, lint, check, or sanity-check a strategy JSON file (config/shared/strategy-library.json, an agent strategy entry, or a pasted strategy object), asks "is this strategy valid?", "why is my strategy field ignored?", "check the strategy schema", or "does this strategy have unknown fields?". Trigger even without the word "validate": pointing at a strategy JSON and asking what is wrong or what will be used is this skill.
